With $i$ last in a total color order, raw downward flags have shifts $s_j(m)=-2d_jm_j+\sum_{\ell>j}(-b_{j\ell})m_\ell$, and a degree-$D$ raw map between word shifts $S,T$ has degree $D+T-S$. Hence a source increasing crossing $\pi$ of degree zero and its reverse multiplier $Q$ of degree $-2b_{jk}$ both have actual degree $-b_{jk}$, and basic $E_iG_j$ has the prescribed shifted commutator $-b_{ij}$. The formal $H_i=E_i^{\mathrm{basic}}\{-d_i(1+h_{\mathrm{input}})\}$ cancels the shift because $h$ increases by $-a_{ij}$ under $G_j$ and $s_j(m-e_i)=s_j(m)+b_{ij}$; it is the formal $H_i$, not the basic $E_i$, that commutes unshiftedly with the spectator flag. [F1, algebra]
